# DisplayModeHeight 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Display](BlitzBasic-Display)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
DisplayModeHeight:Int32 display:Int32, mode:Int32
```

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

The height in pixels of a mode from the list of a display. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* A display or mode number that does not exist gives 0 instead of stopping the program, unlike [GfxModeWidth](GfxModeWidth).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `display` | Int32 | required | The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays). |
| `mode` | Int32 | required | The mode number, from 1 to [CountDisplayModes](CountDisplayModes). |

**Returns:** The height, or 0 if the display or mode does not exist.
